description: Hero section for a single brand/product review page. Includes large conic-gradient score ring, verdict line, primary 'Visit site / Get deal' CTA, and meta (author/date/reading time). Pair with RatingBreakdown + ProsCons immediately below.

eyebrow.hint: Small uppercase label above the H1.

title.hint: H1 text. Defaults to '{brand} review' if omitted.

verdict.hint: One-sentence verdict heading (e.g. 'A premium pick that holds up over time.').

score.hint: 0-10 score. Renders as a conic-gradient ring colored by score band (>=9 success, >=7.5 primary, >=6 warning, else error).

primaryCta.hint: Primary affiliate CTA. rel defaults to 'sponsored noopener'.

dealText.hint: Small uppercase deal tag above the primary CTA (e.g. '20% off this week').

preview.title: Sony WH-1000XM5 review
preview.verdict: Best-in-class ANC with the longest battery in the segment.
